questions.nlq: Hey! Could you help me get the IDs of the things that connect chlorine atoms? I'd love to see what those IDs are.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: In this context, 'ID' means the unique identifier assigned to each atom, i.e., the tag that distinguishes one atom from another.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT neighbor_id AS atom_id
FROM (
    SELECT c.atom_id2 AS neighbor_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
    WHERE a.element = 'cl'
    UNION
    SELECT c.atom_id AS neighbor_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
    WHERE a.element = 'cl'
) n
JOIN atom a2 ON n.neighbor_id = a2.atom_id
WHERE a2.element <> 'cl';

meanings.hidden_knowledge: Here, 'ID' refers to the unique identifier of a bond, which is the tag that distinguishes one chemical bond from another.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';
